generations.conceptPrompt: Late-1980s clip-on numeric pager: a small thick rectangular plastic box with a small rectangular LCD window at the top, a few small buttons on the side or front, and a metal belt clip at the back. Cream beige ABS body, a wide LCD window, two buttons on the side, a dark belt clip. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
